mapper.select: /* DefaultSchGenMapper.selectDefaultSchCompanyCds */ SELECT DISTINCT U.CMPNY_CD FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.DEFAULT_SCH_CD IS NOT NULL AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01'

/* DefaultSchGenMapper.selectDefaultSchUsers */ SELECT U.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , U.SITE_CD AS siteCd , U.USER_CD AS userCd , U.DEFAULT_SCH_CD AS defaultSchCd FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.DEFAULT_SCH_CD IS NOT NULL AND U.SITE_CD IS NOT NULL AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01'

/* DefaultSchGenMapper.selectDefaultSchUser */ SELECT U.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , U.SITE_CD AS siteCd , U.USER_CD AS userCd , U.DEFAULT_SCH_CD AS defaultSchCd FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.DEFAULT_SCH_CD IS NOT NULL AND U.SITE_CD IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1

/* DefaultSchGenMapper.selectActiveSchOptions */ SELECT M.SCH_CD AS schCd , M.SCH_NO AS schNo , M.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS fstSchStrTime , M.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS fstSchEndTime , M.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS secSchStrTime , M.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS secSchEndTime FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND M.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.SCH_NO ASC
